### Triggers & Context
Daily scheduled trigger at 08:00 AM combined with on-demand manual trigger. Initializes current date and time windows.

### Multi-Agent Intelligence Layer
- **Email Triage Agent**: Fetches Google emails, categorizes & sorts by urgency.
- **Calendar Schedule Agent**: Fetches Google Calendar, detects conflicts & computes focus blocks.

### Synthesis & HTML Dashboard Presentation
- **Synthesizer Agent**: Merges email & calendar insights, generates master timeline & priorities.
- **Code Node & HTML Node**: Compiles and presents modern responsive briefing dashboard.
